title: feat: Support config in frontmatter.
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Allows defining diagram specific config from the frontmatter. 

```
---
config:
  sankey:
    nodeAlignment: justify
---
sankey-beta
%%data
```   

Resolves #4630 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

The config will be added using the existing `addDirective` function, which has the necessary security checks. 

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

comments.body:
This is something I'm not sure about. 
Previously, assignWithDepth was a security vulnerability when called without sanitizing. 

The only difference is between merging of dissimilar property types (not really applicable for us), and skipping based on depth (which we were not using).

The vulnerabilities did not work with lodash merge.
